name: Neritic-Ria

civilization.name: Kethrim Ascendancy
civilization.notes: Their vault-cities descend on tethered cables through the cloud decks, harvesting charge from the storms.

description: A single unbroken ocean swallows the horizon, its color shifting from wine-dark deeps to bright shelf-teal. The only interruptions are bioluminescent seas, breaking the swell in a ragged arc.

Breathable air makes every breath a small transaction. Locals, when there are locals, move slowly and speak quietly, conserving everything. Signal chatter rises from the inhabited zones, structured, rhythmic, and unmistakably deliberate.
Local legend among spacers says the planet hums on a frequency just below hearing. Instruments confirm it. Nobody agrees on the source.
Every syndicate scout files the same advice: harvest fast, land light, and never spend a full cycle planetside. The wise ones follow it exactly once.
